facts.fact: The BCEAO's mandate that all interoperable electronic-money transfers across the eight WAEMU states route through PI-SPI took effect on 2 November 2026, with transfer fees capped at 0.8 per cent above 8,000 CFA francs, according to Launch Base Africa.

The BCEAO set a regulatory deadline of 30 September 2026 for institutions to connect to PI-SPI and mandated routing of interoperable e-money transfers through it from 2 November 2026; Wave, which holds about 80 per cent of Senegal's mobile money market, connected on 30 September.
